title: AB1316 (2025-2026 Regular): Hunting licenses: information on firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check, California); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official leginfo.legislature.ca.gov text (Introduced 2025-02-21, via LegiScan getBillText)
provenance.note: Introduced text of 2025-02-21 (no floor vote; this is the last version saved).

operative_text:
Section 3031.1 (Fish and Game Code): (a) Beginning July 1, 2027, the department shall ensure that every person who purchases a hunting license receives, at minimum, information on all of the following topics:
(1) The safe storage of firearms.
(2) California’s child access prevention laws.
(3) Liability for parents and guardians who should have known their child could access a firearm at home.
(4) Basic California firearm laws.
(5) How to legally transfer or relinquish a firearm.
Section 3031.1 (Fish and Game Code): (b) The department, in cooperation with the Department of Justice, may promulgate regulations regarding the implementation of the requirement in subdivision (a), and may include additional information to be provided with a hunting license.
